text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
Here we are at Hanshin Racecourse! Which 
Umamusume is your favorite to win?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I'm rooting for Ikuno Dictus, I think~. 
First place today for sure! Do your best, 
Ikuno!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I'd have to go with Mejiro Palmer. Last 
year's Takarazuka Kinen was just the best!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Maybe Nishino Flower... It might not be 
her best distance, but I really sense 
potential in her...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
No way, no way, it's gotta be Mejiro 
McQueen here!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen is the heavy favorite for 
many visitors today! How about you?

Indeed, at the end of the extended 
microphone stood—

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text:
She's so positive and always gives me 
courage. Today, I... came to watch to get 
some energy from her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Having fought alongside you in the Tenno 
Sho (Spring), I can feel your recent, 
rapid growth firsthand.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The one I must watch out for the most 
today is you. I shall give it everything I 
have...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! The pleasure is all mine! I'm 
looking forward to working with you today!
